## Tips & gotchas

- Ask to have light tabs welded on after lights are installed if mounting variations exist, as this allows a best-guess fitment. [t1619]
- [Partial] Consider powder coating bumpers and sliders together for a matching finish; note that powder coat can be slippery when wet. [t1619]
